doc: Demo control parameters (contracts section 12). The demo-control service is the only writer. 'store' says where the value lives; consumers read it on every cycle unless apply is 'restart'.

params.label: Demo clock (business hours per real hour)
params.doc: Restock planning runs on compressed business time: 60 = one real minute is one business hour. Lead time, coverage, demand and ETAs are shown in business time.

params.label: Supplier lead time (base)
params.doc: Base purchase-order-to-stock time; each product has its own factor (0.5-2x) plus jitter. Applies to open orders.

params.label: Minimum order quantity
params.doc: Smallest restock request; the rule orders more when demand × (lead time + coverage) needs it.

params.label: Background sales per store
params.doc: jr ticks every 250 ms per store; each tick sells with probability rate/240.

params.label: Sell-out gap between stores
params.doc: Pause between stores in make sell-out (when --gap-s is not given).

params.label: Freshness probe interval
params.doc: How often each store's probe position is written.

params.label: Stale after
params.doc: A store's feed is stale when its newest probe is not visible in Redis within this time.

params.label: Shop refresh interval
params.doc: How often the product page asks for availability.

params.label: Exposure latency budget
params.doc: A lookup slower than this counts the session as an exposed journey.

params.label: Jev timeout
params.doc: Past this the rule default is used.

params.label: Jev minimum confidence
params.doc: Lower-confidence choices take the rule default.

params.label: AI kill switch
params.doc: 1 = never call Jev; rule default only. Same key the worker already reads (offers:kill_switch).

params.label: Max cart-at-risk age
params.doc: Older cart-at-risk events are skipped.

params.label: Active cart window
params.doc: Shown read-only: changing it means re-applying the Flink statement (Terraform).

params.label: Safety factor
params.doc: Reorder point = demand × lead time × this.

params.label: Coverage after delivery
params.doc: Order enough to cover the lead time plus this many hours of demand.

params.label: Default demand (no data yet)
params.doc: Used until Flink has learned a product's demand. 0.1/business hour ≈ the default sales rate per product; higher values make every product reorder at start.

params.label: Lead time jitter
params.doc: Each order's lead time varies by up to this much around base × product factor.

params.label: Demand skew between products
params.doc: 0 = every product sells equally; higher = a few products sell much faster.

params.label: Demand window
params.doc: Read-only: sliding window Flink uses to learn demand.
